lines: Q: What's the hardest part of meals for you? Or something else.
A: The hardest part is deciding what to make every day. Sunita keeps asking what to cook.

Q: Which apps do you order groceries on: Zepto, Blinkit, Instamart, BigBasket or Amazon? If you sign me in, I'll read your past orders to learn what your home buys and how often, so the plan and the shopping list fit you from the first week, and I can fill the cart for you. Nothing is ordered without your yes.
A: Blinkit mostly, BigBasket for monthly stuff. Later on the sign in thing.
Q: Which is your main app, and which do you use when something isn't there?
A: Blinkit is the main one. If something's not there, I check BigBasket.
Q: I have Rohit (38), Neha (36) and Vihaan (7) eating at home. Anyone else who eats at home, or anyone who doesn't?
A: That's right, just the three of us. Nobody else eats at home.
Q: Sunita cooks Mon-Sat: Breakfast and Lunch at 8am, Dinner at 7pm. Is that right, and does the cook come for any other meals?
A: Yes, that's right. She doesn't come for any other meals.
Q: Is the cook short of time, say off to the next house, so only a dish or two in the morning?
A: She has about two hours in the morning, so enough time for breakfast, lunch, and packing Vihaan's tiffin.
A: oh and evening Sunita comes at 7:30 now, not 7
Q: On Sunday, when the cook doesn't come, who cooks? Or is a meal eaten out?
A: Neha cooks all three meals on Sunday. We order dinner from Zomato that night.
Q: What did the children have for breakfast over the past week? Tell me in as much detail as you can.
A: Vihaan had poha, bread omelette, aloo paratha, and cornflakes with milk on busy days last week.
Q: The children's lunch over the past week, or their school tiffin?
A: Vihaan's tiffin last week: sandwich, paratha roll, poha, and Maggi on Friday as a treat.
Q: The children's dinner over the past week?
A: He eats what we eat at dinner, just less spicy. Same as us.
Q: What did the adults have for breakfast over the past week? Tell me in as much detail as you can.
A: Poha, besan chilla, bread omelette for us. Parathas on weekends.
Q: The adults' lunch over the past week?
A: Dal chawal roti sabzi raita mostly. Rajma chawal twice last week.
Q: The adults' dinner over the past week?
A: Roti, dal and a sabzi mostly. Paneer bhurji or matar paneer sometimes. Chicken curry on Saturday and Sunday.
Q: Is anyone on a diet? High protein, low carb, diabetic, anything a doctor asked for.
A: No, nobody is on a diet. We eat normal.
Q: Any food rules for the house? Veg, egg or non-veg days, fasting days, allergies, a dish someone won't touch.
A: Eggs are fine any day. Chicken only on weekends, Saturday and Sunday. No non-veg on weekdays.
A: No allergies or fasting. Vihaan just needs food less spicy.
Q: How often do you order in, and on which days?
A: Order in once a week, Sunday dinner from Zomato.
Q: Does anything come on a subscription, like Country Delight or a milkman?
A: Yes, Mother Dairy milk from the milkman, 1 litre daily.
